To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
fuzzy sets are an appropriate mathematical tool for the classification of objects.
the fuzzy K nearest neighbor method is a viable alternative to the crisp version of the algorithm, that it can be used in a variety of applications, and

the fuzzy version of the KNN algorithm is a viable technique for classification, that the method of fuzzy membership assignment is an important consideration, that the fuzzy KNN algorithm is robust to noise in the data, and that the fuzzy K nearest neighbor decision algorithm performs as well as, and sometimes better than, its crisp counterpart.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a fuzzy nearest neighbor decision rule.
the development of a method of classifying a pattern into one of two classes.
the development of a fuzzy K nearest neighbor (FKNN) algorithm for classification of objects in the presence of uncertainty and fuzziness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fuzzy version of the nearest neighbor algorithm is an improvement over its crisp version, and that the fuzzy algorithm is more sensitive to the number of labeled samples.
the fuzzy version of the K nearest neighbor algorithm has been shown to outperform the crisp algorithm in the presence of noisy and incomplete training data.
the fuzzy K nearest neighbor technique is superior to the crisp K nearest neighbor method in the presence of noisy data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fuzzy K nearest neighbor technique is a useful tool in the area of classification.
the use of the fuzzy K nearest neighbor technique has been shown to improve the classification results of the K nearest neighbor method.
the fuzzy K nearest neighbor technique provides a more flexible method of classification than the crisp K nearest neighbor method.

the fuzzy version of the KNN algorithm outperforms the crisp version.
a more robust classifier can be obtained by using a fuzzy version of a K nearest neighbor classifier.
the fuzzy algorithm is more robust to noise than the crisp algorithm.
